hud.title: Event Tracker
step.reach: find a way to get to {{place}}
reach.unknown: there's no way to {{place}} yet; it opens up later in the story
msg.available.story.1: Something seems to be happening at {{place}}...
msg.available.story.2: There's a stir over at {{place}}. Maybe go take a look?
msg.available.home.1: It's time to visit {{name}} at {{poss}} home, {{place}}.
msg.available.home.2: {{name}} seems to be home at {{place}}. Why not stop by?
msg.available.rainy.1: On a rainy day like this, {{name}} might be at {{place}}.
msg.available.evening.1: {{name}} might be out at {{place}} this evening.
msg.available.any.3: Now might be a good time to find {{name}} at {{place}}.
msg.reminder.hours.1: {{name}} should be {{where}} in a couple of hours, around {{time}}.
msg.reminder.hours.2: Around {{time}}, {{name}} might be {{where}}. There's still time to get ready.
msg.reminder.hour.1: {{name}} should be {{where}} around {{time}}. Head out soon to catch {{obj}}!
msg.reminder.hour.2: In about an hour, {{name}} might be {{where}}. Better start heading over.
msg.leave.story: Time to head out to {{place}} (about {{away}} away). Something might happen there around {{time}}.
msg.leave.1: Time to head out: {{name}} should be at {{place}} around {{time}}, about {{away}} away.
msg.leave.2: {{place}} is about {{away}} away. Leave now to catch {{name}} around {{time}}!
msg.morning: Today looks like a good day to see {{name}} at {{place}}{{window}}.
msg.morning.rainy: It's raining. A perfect day to find {{name}} at {{place}}{{window}}.
msg.tomorrow.1: {{lead}} A good day to find {{name}} at {{place}}.
status.special: Special trigger: can't be started by visiting
wait.upcoming-festival.not: a day without a festival coming up
menu.chip.now.tip: Every requirement is met and it's the right time of day.
menu.chip.today.tip:
Available now, or everything is met
and it can start later today.
menu.chip.not-today.tip:
Everything's done; it just can't happen today.
Waiting on the weather, day, season, Green Rain
or a festival, or today's time has passed.
menu.chip.locked.tip: Also list events that need more hearts.
menu.pinned.how: Pin NPCs from the Hearts tab (or point at one and press {{key}}), and story events from the Story tab.
menu.pinned.no-match: None of your pinned NPCs have events matching your search or filters.
menu.hearts.no-match: No heart events match your search or filters.
menu.hearts.all-seen: {{count}} NPCs whose events you've all seen are on the Completed tab.
menu.story.no-match: No story events match your search or filters.
menu.story.none: No unseen story events right now.
menu.completed.no-match: No completed events match your search.
menu.completed.none-hearts: You haven't seen any tracked heart events yet.
menu.completed.none-story: You haven't seen any tracked story events yet.
menu.caught-up: Nothing pending. You're all caught up!
menu.unreachable: {{count}} event(s) can no longer happen (an alternate version was seen).
menu.hidden: Details hidden until it's unlocked (spoiler-free mode).
menu.travel.here: You're here! Events start when you arrive, so step out and come back in.
menu.festival: Festival here today, {{start}}-{{end}}. Events here can't start during it.
toast.no-events: {{name}} has no heart events to track.
config.pin-key.tip: Pin or unpin the NPC under your cursor, in the world or on the Social tab.
config.auto-pin.tip: Pin your spouse, roommate and anyone you're dating automatically. Unpinning them sticks.
config.spoiler-free.tip: Hide where events happen, their requirements and what they lead to until they're unlocked. Good for a first playthrough.
config.section.reminders.tip: Messages for pinned NPCs' events. Times are in-game time.
config.morning.tip: When the day starts, mention pinned NPC events that can happen today.
config.remind-before.tip: Remind you {{interval}} before a pinned NPC's event can start, so you have time to get there.
config.leave-now.tip: Estimate the walk to the event (from where you are, on foot or horse) and remind you when it's time to set off.
config.leave-buffer.tip: Extra in-game minutes added to the walking estimate, in case you stop along the way.
config.available.tip: Show a message when a pinned NPC's event can happen right now.
config.tomorrow.tip: From 6:00 pm, mention pinned NPC events that can't happen today but should work tomorrow, based on the weather forecast.
config.reminder-sound.tip: Played with reminders and heads-ups. Changing it plays a preview.
config.available-sound.tip: Played when a pinned NPC's event can happen right now. Changing it plays a preview.
config.popup-seconds.tip: How many seconds reminder messages stay on screen.
config.map-markers.tip: Show a heart on the map where pinned NPCs' events can happen today. Hover it for details.
config.unpinned-reminders.tip: Also send reminders for events you haven't pinned, at the times picked below and again when they start. Only events with a start time get them, so ones that can happen all day don't flood the screen.
msg.unpinned-more: +{{count}} more events coming up ({{key}} to see them all)
config.hud-fade: Fade HUD when in the way
config.hud-fade.tip: Fades the HUD tracker while you walk under it or the mouse is over it. It comes back while you drag it with the right mouse button.
config.hud-fade-hover.tip: Fades the HUD tracker while the mouse is over it too, not just while you walk under it. Turn off to keep it readable when you point at it.
config.hud-fade-opacity.tip: How much of the HUD tracker still shows while it's faded: 0% hides it completely, 100% doesn't fade it at all.
hud.story-snoozed: Story event at {{location}}: snoozed until tomorrow
config.story-reminders.tip: Send reminders for story events you've pinned (pin them from the Story tab), the same way as for pinned NPCs.
status.door-festival: Doors are locked for today's festival
door.festival: Shops and houses are locked for today's festival
door.hearts: Door locked: needs {{hearts}} hearts with {{name}} ({{more}} to go)
door.hearts.ok: Door opens for friends of {{name}} ({{hearts}} hearts)
door.town-key: Door open any time (you have the Town Key)
door.never-open: The door is locked at that time of day (open {{open}}-{{close}}). The Town Key would open it.
step.door-letter: the door opens with a letter you haven't received yet
step.door-closed: the door is locked at that time of day
step.unknown: a requirement the tracker can't check
spoiler-prompt: Playing for the first time? Spoiler-free mode hides where events you haven't unlocked yet happen, what they need, and what they lead to. You can change this anytime in the mod's settings.
hud.nothing: Nothing pinned to track right now ({{key}} to pin more)
config.hud-layout.tip: Detailed gives what's happening today two lines (what and where, then when). Compact puts every entry on one short line, coloured by how soon, so more fit when you track a lot.
config.hud-order.tip: By urgency puts what needs doing soonest at the top, so it's never cut off. Alphabetical lists NPCs A-Z, then story events.
config.hud-theme.tip: How the HUD tracker looks. Community Center has the bundle book's title tab and a few Junimos; Joja is a dark box in Joja blue under a Joja banner; Spirit's Eve is dark and spooky. The season themes come in light and dark (see HUD mode), and Seasonal changes with the calendar.
config.hud-mode.tip: Light or dark, for the season themes (Seasonal, Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter). The other themes have one look each.
cond.spouse-bed: A bed for your spouse in the farmhouse
cond.cc-or-joja-done.not: Community Center and Joja Warehouse not completed yet
status.on-entry: No requirements: plays when you next go there, once you can reach it
hud.on-entry: Plays when you next go there
menu.pinned.missing: Pinned event #{{id}} at {{location}} isn't in today's data. Its mod may add it only on some days, or the mod was removed.
